Dell’s Servers — What’s Changed

Dell’s new line — announced today — uses café-grade cooling. Dell Technologies has announced the PowerEdge R7xx series, a refresh of its mainstream two-socket rack server line aimed at enterprise data centres. Paragraph 1 of the article body provides further detail and context for readers evaluating the announcement.

The new systems use a redesigned airflow path and higher-efficiency power supplies, which Dell says reduces power draw at typical utilisation levels. Paragraph 2 of the article body provides further detail and context for readers evaluating the announcement.
